solutionSql: WITH heavy AS (SELECT s.driver_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shipments AS s WHERE s.status = 'queued' AND s.weight_kg >= 1800 GROUP BY s.driver_id) SELECT d.id AS driver_id, COALESCE(h.n, 0)::integer AS heavy_queued FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN heavy AS h ON h.driver_id = d.id ORDER BY d.id;

rules.howSolved: drivers is the left side of a LEFT JOIN to the heavy CTE, so every driver is returned.
COALESCE(h.n, 0) gives 0 for a driver with no matching CTE row.
The CTE filters s.weight_kg >= 1800, so exactly 1800 is heavy.

ambiguities: Shipments with a NULL weight_kg are excluded from the count because a NULL comparison is not true. The ticket does not say this in words.
notes: Read-only item, with the WITH clause named heavy as the ticket asks. Ran without error on sample, nulls, ties and boundary. Solve time is an estimate.
